mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.code, r.name, r.description, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.role_permissions rp WHERE rp.role_id = r.id) AS permission_count FROM public.roles r WHERE r.active = true AND r.code <> 'PATIENT' ORDER BY r.code
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.roles WHERE code = #{code})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.roles (id, code, name, description, active, row_version) VALUES (#{id}, #{code}, #{name}, #{description}, #{active}, #{rowVersion})
mapper.update: UPDATE public.roles SET name = #{role.name}, description = #{role.description}, active = #{role.active}, row_version = row_version + 1 WHERE id = #{role.id} AND row_version = #{expectedRowVersion}
mapper.select: SELECT p.code FROM public.role_permissions rp JOIN public.permissions p ON p.id = rp.permission_id WHERE rp.role_id = #{roleId} ORDER BY p.code
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.permissions WHERE code IN #{code}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.role_permissions (role_id, permission_id) SELECT #{roleId}, p.id FROM public.permissions p WHERE p.code IN #{code} ON CONFLICT (role_id, permission_id) DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO public.role_permissions (role_id, permission_id) SELECT #{targetRoleId}, permission_id FROM public.role_permissions WHERE role_id = #{sourceRoleId} ON CONFLICT (role_id, permission_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.sql: SELECT r.id, r.code, r.name, r.description, r.active, r.row_version, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.role_permissions rp WHERE rp.role_id = r.id) AS permission_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.accounts a WHERE a.role_id = r.id) AS user_count FROM public.roles r
mapper.select: ORDER BY r.code COLLATE "C" LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT id, code, name, description, http_method, endpoint, module, use_cases, sensitive FROM public.permissions ORDER BY module, code
